description: This file defines the PageBreak class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, which manages page break information in spreadsheet worksheets. It includes properties for break type, coordinate, and maximum row or column, as well as methods to access and manipulate these attributes.

classes.name: PageBreak
classes.description: Represents a page break in a spreadsheet worksheet, including its type, position, and related attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a PageBreak object with type, coordinate, and optional maximum row or column value.

methods.name: getBreakType
methods.description: Returns the type of the page break.

methods.name: getCoordinate
methods.description: Returns the coordinate of the page break as a string.

methods.name: getMaxColOrRow
methods.description: Returns the maximum column or row index related to the break.

methods.name: getColumnInt
methods.description: Returns the column index as an integer.

methods.name: getColumnString
methods.description: Returns the column as a string.
